modelAreas.scientificScope: Earth's observed 71% ocean coverage is a surface-area constraint, not a direct water-mass-fraction output. The planned context will infer surface ocean coverage from water inventory, planet size, gravity, climate state, and a bounded Earth-hypsometry basin-capacity proxy.
assumptions: Outputs will be global coverage diagnostics. Hypsometry is represented by a compact Earth-calibrated basin-fill proxy, not a topographic map, mantle water-cycle solver, or plate-tectonic terrain generator.
knownLimitations: No exact continent/ocean geography, dynamic sea level, crustal thickness model, erosion/sedimentation cycle, mantle water partitioning, or regional bathymetry is solved.

modelAreas.label: Icy moon sputtered oxygen exosphere
modelAreas.scientificScope: Europa's water-ice surface is dissociated by magnetospheric particles into H2 and O2; Juno/JADE pickup-ion measurements constrain Europa O2 production near 12 kg/s, while Hubble/Nature observations establish an extremely tenuous abiotic O2 atmosphere.
assumptions: Outputs are global support classes and broad O2 production estimates only. Exosphere O2 is abiotic, exosphere-only, and never added to retained pressure, greenhouse warming, breathability, or life confidence.
knownLimitations: No MHD or plasma transport, no neutral column-density map, no sputtering-yield chemistry network, no local leading/trailing hemisphere structure, and no plume time variability.

modelAreas.label: Radius-valley boundary context
modelAreas.scientificScope: The super-Earth/sub-Neptune radius valley is a population-level feature tied to radius, period, irradiation, and atmospheric loss, not a deterministic single-planet label.
assumptions: The context only explains whether a boundary-family interpretation is close-in and irradiation-relevant.
knownLimitations: Does not infer formation history, atmospheric mass loss, or core/envelope composition for an individual planet.

modelAreas.label: Host-frame stability
modelAreas.scientificScope: Uses the existing home-system host-frame stability outputs for S-type, P-type, and hierarchical companion constraints.
assumptions: Host-frame stability is a bounded analytic context, not a full secular or N-body integration.
knownLimitations: Does not model Kozai-Lidov cycles, secular resonances, or migration history.

modelAreas.label: Selected-frame orbital architecture
modelAreas.scientificScope: Consumes the upstream mutual-Hill architecture diagnostic for planets, gas giants, and brown-dwarf companions in one host frame.
assumptions: Adjacent-pair spacing is most meaningful for near-coplanar, low-to-moderate eccentricity systems.
knownLimitations: Not an N-body integration; eccentric or inclined systems downgrade confidence.

modelAreas.label: Mutual Hill spacing
assumptions: Circular coplanar two-body boundary is used as a conservative diagnostic threshold.
knownLimitations: Does not prove long-term stability for eccentric, inclined, or resonant systems.

modelAreas.label: Eccentricity overlap
modelAreas.scientificScope: Flags adjacent pairs whose simplified orbital ranges overlap.
assumptions: Uses semi-major axis and eccentricity only.
knownLimitations: No apsidal phase, inclination, resonance, or secular-cycle modeling.

modelAreas.label: Parent synchronous orbit
modelAreas.scientificScope: r_sync = (G M_parent / omega_parent^2)^(1/3).
assumptions: Parent mass and rotation are treated as current bulk values.
knownLimitations: Does not evolve parent spin or include oblateness/back-reaction.

modelAreas.label: Moon migration direction
modelAreas.scientificScope: Consumes upstream tidal da/dt and synchronous-orbit context to classify inward, outward, mixed, or unknown migration.
assumptions: Direction is more robust than exact tidal timescale under uncertain Q/k2.
knownLimitations: Exact migration times depend on uncertain dissipation and parent spin evolution.

modelAreas.label: Eccentricity persistence
modelAreas.scientificScope: Consumes upstream forced eccentricity, resonance, migration, heating, and damping context.
assumptions: Maintained/damping/overdriven states are qualitative persistence classes.
knownLimitations: Not a resonant Hamiltonian or de/dt integrator.

modelAreas.label: Sustained tidal heating
modelAreas.scientificScope: Separates current tidal heat from heat that is likely maintained by resonance or forced eccentricity.
assumptions: Supports moon interiors and habitability persistence as a confidence context before score changes.
knownLimitations: Does not solve thermal-orbital equilibrium or evolving Q.

modelAreas.label: Moon-system torque budget
modelAreas.scientificScope: Consumes the upstream moon-system torque proxy to classify net inward, outward, balanced, or unknown trend.
assumptions: Proxy is useful for direction, not exact torque magnitude.
knownLimitations: Not an exact angular-momentum integral.

modelAreas.label: Parent ring context
modelAreas.scientificScope: Routes existing ring, Roche-limit, and solved moon-system constraints into a single parent-body context.
assumptions: Ring interpretation uses existing Roche/ring models plus assigned moon context; no ring age or migration history is solved.
knownLimitations: Does not model collisional ring evolution, shepherding resonances, or detailed ring particle dynamics.

modelAreas.label: Parent radiation and plasma context
modelAreas.scientificScope: Routes existing giant magnetosphere, sputtering plasma, and moon-system torque/heating context into qualitative radiation notes.
assumptions: Radiation and plasma context is qualitative unless a dedicated calibrated magnetodisk model is present.
knownLimitations: Does not produce detailed radiation-belt maps, magnetodisk transport, or time-variable plasma environments.

modelAreas.label: Generation and repair guidance
modelAreas.scientificScope: Turns shared architecture and moon stability context into generation hard blocks, warnings, and repair suggestions.
assumptions: Hard-blocks only established physical impossibilities or upstream unstable labels.
knownLimitations: Repair suggestions are advisory; uncertain cases remain warnings.

modelAreas.label: Habitability persistence bridge
modelAreas.scientificScope: Routes sustained heat, unstable dynamics, and unknown orbital context into persistence confidence and visible reasons.
assumptions: First pass affects confidence and notes before direct habitability score penalties.
knownLimitations: Does not assert life and does not prove ocean permanence.

modelAreas.label: Dynamical timeline events
modelAreas.scientificScope: Uses shared context to add qualitative timeline entries for migration, damping, sustained heating, and crowded architecture.
assumptions: No precise event dates are added unless an upstream calibrated timescale exists.
knownLimitations: Not an orbital-history integrator.
